label: Propofol PD — Eleveld two-slope BIS sigmoid

parameters.label: effect-site concentration at half-maximal BIS effect (reference, age 35)

extraction.tier_rationale: Age-corrected half-effect concentration from the Eleveld pooled PK-PD analysis (1033 patients).

parameters.label: Hill slope for Ce > Ce50
parameters.covariate_model: gamma2 = 1.89 when Ce > Ce50 (steeper above the half-effect point)

known_failure_modes.condition: BIS is an EEG-derived index with device-specific behaviour and known artefacts
known_failure_modes.behavior: Population BIS predictions carry large between-subject variability (reported MDAPE ~10 BIS units) and depend on the processed-EEG monitor; not an individual prediction.

extraction.tier_rationale: Two-slope sigmoid BIS model from the Eleveld pooled PK-PD analysis (1033 patients), the validated PD companion to the Eleveld PK kernel. Steeper above Ce50 than below. Composes onto the Eleveld (or any) propofol PK model; the BIS endpoint's device dependence and between-subject variability are flagged as a failure mode. review_status remains unverified pending human PDF confirmation.

source_review.reviewed_by: automated source cross-check (Claude Opus 4.8 via Hypnos research agents)
source_review.method: fetched open-source reproductions, primary-paper PubMed abstracts, and/or the tci R package source, then numerically compared each curated value against the fetched values
source_review.notes: E0 93, Ce50 3.08, Ce50 age coefficient -0.00635, gamma_low 1.47, gamma_high 1.89, and ke0 0.146 confirmed against the hard-coded tci theta_pd vector c(3.08,0.146,93.0,1.47,...,-0.00635,1.24,1.89) and re-confirmed in opentiva. The two-slope (dual-gamma, switching at Ce=Ce50) structure is corroborated. HUMAN ITEM: confirm against the primary BJA table.

notes: BIS = E0 - Emax * Ce^gamma/(Ce50^gamma + Ce^gamma), gamma = gamma_low (1.47) if Ce <= Ce50 else gamma_high (1.89). Ce50 age-corrected: 3.08*exp(-0.00635*(age-35)). Continuous at Ce=Ce50 (half-maximal effect). Pair with the Eleveld PK model for a fully-Eleveld PK-PD BIS trajectory; the composed tier is the worst of PK (A) and this PD (B) = B.
